summary.text: Steve Santarsiero is a Democratic state senator who has represented Pennsylvania Senate District 10 since December 2018 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. An attorney and former social studies teacher, he previously served in the state House.

paragraphs.text: Steve Santarsiero earned a B.A. from Tufts University, an M.Ed. from Holy Family University and a J.D. from the University of Pennsylvania Law School, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists his professional experience as working as an attorney and as a social studies teacher at Bensalem High School.
He also served on the Lower Makefield Board of Supervisors, including as board chair.
Santarsiero previously represented District 31 in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives before taking office in the state Senate on December 1, 2018.

For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists his committee assignments as State Government, Consumer Protection and Professional Licensure, Institutional Sustainability and Innovation, Judiciary, and Rules and Executive Nominations.
Ballotpedia lists Republican Gregory Bankos Jr., a Plumstead Township supervisor, as his opponent in the November 3, 2026 general election.
